mapper.sql: project_id, chapter_number, generation_session_id, draft_calls, review_calls, revise_calls, compression_calls, revise_rounds, retry_count, human_intervened, generation_duration_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, final_word_count, generation_started_at, generation_ended_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO generation_metrics (project_id, chapter_number, generation_session_id, draft_calls, review_calls, revise_calls, compression_calls, revise_rounds, retry_count, human_intervened, generation_duration_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, final_word_count, generation_started_at, generation_ended_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{chapterNumber}, #{generationSessionId}, #{draftCalls}, #{reviewCalls}, #{reviseCalls}, #{compressionCalls}, #{reviseRounds}, #{retryCount}, #{humanIntervened}, #{generationDurationMs}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{finalWordCount}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE draft_calls = VALUES(draft_calls), review_calls = VALUES(review_calls), revise_calls = VALUES(revise_calls), compression_calls = VALUES(compression_calls), revise_rounds = VALUES(revise_rounds), retry_count = VALUES(retry_count), human_intervened = VALUES(human_intervened), generation_duration_ms = VALUES(generation_duration_ms), input_tokens = VALUES(input_tokens), output_tokens = VALUES(output_tokens), total_tokens = VALUES(total_tokens), final_word_count = VALUES(final_word_count), generation_started_at = COALESCE(generation_metrics.generation_started_at, VALUES(generation_started_at)), generation_ended_at = COALESCE(VALUES(generation_ended_at), generation_metrics.generation_ended_at)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS session_count, COALESCE(SUM(draft_calls), 0) AS draft_calls, COALESCE(SUM(review_calls), 0) AS review_calls, COALESCE(SUM(revise_calls), 0) AS revise_calls, COALESCE(SUM(compression_calls), 0) AS compression_calls, COALESCE(SUM(revise_rounds), 0) AS revise_rounds, COALESCE(SUM(retry_count), 0) AS retry_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN human_intervened THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS human_intervened_count, COALESCE(SUM(generation_duration_ms), 0) AS generation_duration_ms, CASE WHEN COUNT(input_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(input_tokens) END AS input_tokens, CASE WHEN COUNT(output_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(output_tokens) END AS output_tokens, CASE WHEN COUNT(total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(total_tokens) END AS total_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(final_word_count), 0) AS final_word_count, MIN(generation_started_at) AS started_at, MAX(generation_ended_at) AS ended_at FROM generation_metrics WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
